description: Work with Hermes from ChatGPT and other MCP clients. Run agents, manage tasks and schedules, and change settings with version history and rollback.

writes.label: Allow changes
writes.description: Allow agent runs and changes to tasks, profiles, schedules and settings. Turn off for read-only access. Restart HTTP MCP after saving.

auth_enabled.label: Require an access token
auth_enabled.description: Check the Bearer token on HTTP requests. Turn off to allow access without a token; the server still listens only on the local address 127.0.0.1. Restart HTTP MCP after saving.

auth_token.label: Access token
auth_token.description: Enter a token of 32–256 characters: A–Z, a–z, 0–9, _ or -. Hermes stores it in the profile secrets without displaying its value. Restart HTTP MCP after saving and use the same Bearer token in your client.
